rule.name: OGNL Expression Injection via Action Name
rule.rule_desc: The code invokes an interpreter, process, dynamic expression, or template-execution mechanism. Trace executable selection and evaluated content to their trust boundaries.
rule.vuln_desc: If an attacker controls interpreted syntax or the operation selected, code or commands may run with the application’s privileges, allowing data theft, state changes, or service disruption.
rule.developer: Replace externally influenced evaluation with fixed operations and data-only inputs. Use separate argument arrays for processes, allowlist permitted operations, and keep untrusted text out of executable templates or expressions.
rule.reviewer: Confirm no user-controlled data is passed to ValueStack evaluation methods. This can be confirmed as an issue when the matched path is reachable and required controls are missing, weak, or inconsistent.

rule.name: Dynamic Method Invocation Enabled

rule.reviewer: Confirm DMI is disabled in all Struts configuration files. This can be confirmed as an issue when the matched path is reachable and required controls are missing, weak, or inconsistent.

rule.name: File Upload Without Type and Size Restrictions
rule.rule_desc: The application accepts uploaded content. Identify storage destinations, execution behavior, filename handling, and the effective size and type checks.
rule.vuln_desc: A crafted upload may execute as application code, overwrite files, disclose data through later processing, or exhaust storage if the upload crosses the intended content and filesystem boundaries.
rule.developer: Allowlist required file types, inspect content rather than trusting extensions, bound sizes, generate server-side names, and store uploads outside executable paths with appropriate access controls.
rule.reviewer: Confirm file upload interceptors enforce type allowlists and size limits. This can be confirmed as an issue when the matched path is reachable and required controls are missing, weak, or inconsistent.
